PHENOMENON.Definition: something that happens and can be observed and studied

GET STUCK IN.Definition: start doing something with energy and enthusiasm

PERTINENT.Definition: closely connected to what is happening now

STIMULATE.Definition: make more active and help to grow

WAGES.Definition: amounts of money people are paid for their work

COMIC BOOK.Definition: a magazine that tells stories using drawings

DIG DOWN.Definition: look more closely and in more detail

COMICS.Definition: stories told through a series of drawings

DUTIFULLY.Definition: as they are expected to, without complaining

SIMPLISTIC.Definition: too basic, ignoring how complicated things really are

DISPOSABLE INCOME.Definition: money left to spend after paying taxes and essential costs

HYPERINFLATION.Definition: an extremely fast rise in prices that cannot be controlled

STOCK MARKET.Definition: a place where shares in companies are bought and sold

SALARY.Definition: a fixed amount of money paid regularly, usually every month, for a job

TARGET.Definition: the level that someone officially aims to reach

PAYSLIP.Definition: a document from an employer showing how much someone has earned

VAULTS.Definition: strong, secure rooms for keeping money and valuable things

CURRENCY.Definition: a system of money used in a country

IRRELEVANT.Definition: not important; not connected to what matters

ON AND OFF.Definition: from time to time, not continuously

MONETARY SYSTEM.Definition: the money in use and the way it is created and controlled

JARGON.Definition: special words used by a particular group that others find hard to understand

TERMINOLOGY.Definition: special words used in a particular subject

POLICYMAKERS.Definition: people, usually in government, who decide on plans and rules

UNPREDICTABLE.Definition: likely to change in ways nobody can know in advance

UNSTABLE.Definition: likely to change suddenly; not secure

BARGAIN.Definition: an agreement in which each side gives or promises something
